measured: the demodulator's DDC IF against the tuner's IF: which readback locates the tone, and whether the LO side and Spec_inv matter
bench: RTL2832U + R820T-family tuner, 28.8 MHz crystal, behind a USB analyzer with switchable TARGET-A power; no signal source, antenna input sees noise only

candidate_space: tone side in [below the LO, above the LO] x pset_iffreq IF in ["3570000 Hz (DVB-T 6 MHz (Table 4-1 row 2))", "4063000 Hz (ATSC / ISDB-T 6 MHz (rows 1, 7))", "4070000 Hz (DVB-T 7 MHz (row 3))", "4570000 Hz (DVB-T 7/8 MHz, DTMB (rows 4, 5, 8))", "4571428.571428572 Hz (the demodulator's power-on pset_iffreq, 32/7 MHz)", "0 Hz (zero IF (9.3 example))"] x Spec_inv 0/1 x the tone's IF (|RF - LO|) from 250000 Hz to 12000000 Hz in 250000 Hz steps
how_the_tone_is_found: the DDC shifts the ADC's spectrum by pset_iffreq and the demodulator's channel filter (8 MHz, Table 7) passes what lands within about 4 MHz of it: a readback taken after that filter responds only while the tone's IF is within the band around the DDC's IF (and, if the side and Spec_inv matter, only on one side), so its response against the tone's IF locates the tone; a readback taken before the channel filter responds wherever the tuner's own IF filter passes the tone. The source stays fixed throughout; a tone-off reading opens the record
